description: This Java source file defines the 'Engine' class within the 'org.apache.ofbiz.service.config.model' package. It models the <engine> element in a configuration XML, encapsulating attributes such as 'name', 'class', and associated <parameter> elements. The class provides methods to access these attributes and parameters, supporting configuration parsing and object-oriented representation of engine configurations.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Models an <engine> configuration element with attributes 'name' and 'class', and associated parameters.

methods.name: Engine

methods.description: Returns the string value of a parameter identified by name, or null if not found.
